predictions.analysis_stopped: if a must-hold fails, analyse reports no statistic and leaves none in the artifact: it records the failing checks under analysis_stopped, discards any earlier results and leaves the status at 'scored', so that a cause fixed outside the artifact can be re-analysed. Nothing about a failing must-hold is reported as a result
predictions.breaker_note: v is an exact symmetry of the loss only on steps whose scored structures have no helix longer than 30 pairs; 11 of the 13 TR0 sequences whose allowed pairs admit a 31+ pair run break it (runs/2026-10-10_mxfold2_vg_breaker; |v.g| up to ~0.4 on a step). On those steps the projection removes a component of the step that the loss does see, so 'no accuracy cost' is a measured outcome, not a tautology; every other change the projection makes is float32 rounding of 30 entries

must_hold.adam_checkpoints: the epoch-10 checkpoint this script scores for Adam seeds 20261006-08 is sha256-identical to the one collect-existing traced for the Adam row's v.w, so the row's F and its drift come from the same file
must_hold.bound_logged: projection runs: every logged post satisfies |post| <= its logged bound, and the initial projection's post its bound (re-checked from the logs)
must_hold.config_matches_arm: every new run's logged configuration is the arm it is tabulated as: projection-init.json records projected, planted, the optimiser class, lr and l2_weight as the process built them (AdamW, lr 1e-3, l2 0.01 for the AdamW arm and 0 for the projection arm, planted null), and every recorded attempt's argv and environment carry that arm's flags (--seed, --epochs 10, hinge_mix, --score-loss-weight 1.0, the TR0 list, MXF_PROJECT 0/1, MXF_GAUGE_LAMBDA 0, no MXF_PROJECT_PLANTED, threads 1, the device pinned; --optimizer AdamW --l2-weight 0.01 on the AdamW arm and neither flag on the projection arm)
must_hold.continuity: every run, new or collected: gauge-epoch-e v_dot_w_start == gauge-epoch-(e-1) v_dot_w exactly (e = 2..10), and v_dot_w(10) equals the epoch-10 checkpoint's v.w (evaluator's ckpt_vdot) within 1e-12 * max(1, |x|). Stated exactly: within ONE process the first of those is true by construction, because the gauge hooks set the next epoch's v_dot_w_start from the epoch they have just recorded (mxfold2_gauge_hooks.py:206); it bites across a resume, where the start is measured on the loaded checkpoint. The substantive per-epoch check is the NEW runs' own measurement: scripts/mxfold2_ablation_train.py reads v.w from the live parameters at the top of every epoch (vw-epoch-k.npz 'start'), and that value must equal the previous epoch's last logged post exactly (the initial pre or post for epoch 1) and the hooks' recorded v_dot_w_start exactly
must_hold.existing: the evaluator artifact AND the gauge-runs artifact (runs/2026-10-08_mxfold2_gauge_runs/metrics.json, which supplies the reg and SGD rows' status, trajectory_exact and attempts) are tracked and unmodified; recomputing S2's SD at epoch 10 and mean |step| from its recorded traces and every arm's F mean and SD from its F_per_model reproduces the recorded values exactly; the Adam traces equal ckpt_vdot of every checkpoint on disk and init_vdot(seed) exactly; every reg run is recorded complete with trajectory_exact true and has 10 finite gauge records starting at init_vdot(seed) within 1e-12 * max(1, |x|); the complete SGD run's records equal the evaluator's S1 trace exactly
must_hold.hooks_only_read: the logged v.w does not move between steps within an epoch (pre[t+1] == post[t] exactly); for the AdamW runs post == raw exactly; each epoch's first pre equals its v_dot_w_start and its last post its v_dot_w within 1e-12 * max(1, |x|); epoch 1's v_dot_w_start equals projection-init.json's post (projection) or pre (AdamW) exactly
must_hold.inputs_pinned: preregister refuses unless every pinned code file (RUN_CODE and this launcher) is tracked and unmodified, and records the sha256 of this launcher (analysis_code_sha256), of the registered constants (the run table, the seeds, the epochs, the band, the bootstrap, the worker count) and of the two untracked training INPUTS: the TR0 list data/TR0-canonicals.lst and the seed study's arch.conf. must_hold.raw_step_nonzero: every epoch of every new run took at least one optimiser step and the raw step moved v.w (sum |raw - pre| > 0): a dead optimiser would satisfy every bound
must_hold.registration: collect-existing, smoke-gpu and run refuse unless the artifact is tracked and unmodified and predictions == PRED; score and analyse check PRED and every shard sha256; smoke-gpu and run refuse unless the RUN_CODE sha256s (and the installed mxfold2/train.py) equal those recorded at registration; run also needs a session leader, a tree clean outside runs/, collect-existing passed, G1 passed and make gpu reporting both cards free

must_hold.scored_set: every scored TS0 sequence matches the evaluation set's sha256 (asserted in the worker; a mismatch exits nonzero and is recorded as score_failed); the sequences with reference pairs are the same set for every model AND number exactly 1,304, which is also the evaluator's n_scored for the Adam models the test compares against

predictions.projection_spec: w <- w - ((v.w)/117) v: c = (b[0] - 2 sum W[0, 2:31]) / 117 in float64 on the CPU, b[0] -= c, W[0, 2:31] += 2c, written back in float32 (scripts/mxfold2_vproject.project_v_); applied once after the model is built, before the first step, and after every optimiser step (a torch step post-hook between the raw-step log and the post log); Adam's moment estimates are not touched

void_and_resume.crash: any other non-zero exit resumes from the newest loadable checkpoint (the gauge hooks restore the RNG sidecar), at most 2 recoveries per run; a resumed GPU run is flagged trajectory_exact = false. void_and_resume.driver_death: status RUNNING with no live process of this run is a fault (scripts/predecessor.py rule), recorded under failed_attempts; after the artifact is committed run may be relaunched and resumes unfinished runs, the recovery count carried over
void_and_resume.nan: a NaN/inf loss or v.w (stdout 'Loss: nan', a non-finite gauge or vw record, or the runner's NON-FINITE exit) marks a run diverged; it is not rerun without asking
void_and_resume.terminal_statuses: the run phase ends with every run in one of complete, diverged, failed, bound_violation. If any is failed or bound_violation the artifact's status is 'trained, with runs that failed or were stopped' (and the phase exits nonzero), which score and analyse accept: only the analysis can report what PRED registers for those outcomes. The run phase is not relaunched from it
